page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The configuration provides 80 dedicated physical cores and 80 vCPUs with a single thread per core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading resource sharing.

The instance features 768.0 GB of system memory, which establishes a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 9.6 GB per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be provisioned via network-attached block storage. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included in this configuration.

With its high memory density and dedicated core allocation, the ecs.hfr6.20xlarge offers predictable performance for memory-bound enterprise workloads. The absence of local storage and GPU hardware makes it a specialized option for workloads that rely on network-attached storage. This instance is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, caching layers, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
